Vendored browser bundle for permanent launch metadata. The site does not need a build step.
Regenerate only by rebundling these exact package versions with esbuild for the browser,
aliasing node "crypto" to crypto-browserify and "stream" to stream-browserify.

@irys/web-upload@0.0.15
@irys/web-upload-solana@0.1.8

sha256 irys-bundle.js
d092fe35a5f1f6c17c3fb8d5e6fc560ac829fbc56e116f0fa37632edd225a5f3

The bundle is served from this site (script-src 'self'). It is loaded only when a launch stores metadata.
